title: PDF visual-candidate worker matrix
target: Real visual-candidate extraction on the committed three-PDF golden corpus
contract: Source PDF hashes, candidate counts, ordered candidate signatures, degraded-page counts, and estimated cost remain identical.
summary: Added a real-PDF worker matrix; no production worker setting changed because the leading candidate did not clear the measurement-noise threshold.
why_equivalent: Every profile executes the same collect_candidates path against the same three golden PDFs with isolated output directories; only the worker count varies.

checks.name: PDF candidate benchmark and worker tests
Full matrix outcomes
checks.detail: All eight worker profiles retained all three source hashes, counts, candidate signatures, degraded-page counts, and zero estimated cost.

workload: Three committed golden PDFs; workers one through eight; two warmups and seven measured samples per profile; 15 samples for the targeted 4-vs-5 confirmation.
limitations: The corpus covers three dense PDFs and visual-candidate extraction only; it does not represent every PDF class or downstream crop/OCR behavior.
residual_risks: Other PDF worker pools require independent benchmarks.
notes: Worker four had the fastest initial median, but the 15-sample confirmation reduced the improvement to 2.56%, below the 12.02% noise threshold; the production five-worker baseline remains unchanged.
